general_summary: Nuno Montenegro's office boasts a team that can cater to the full range of technical project planning specialties, from urban planning to the design of public and private developments. The two cornerstones behind its concept are the set of partnerships it has entered into and its drive to foster experimental research. Montenegro's team can provide a design-oriented development concept, the hands-on benefit of a small dynamic company with a well-built network of knowledge connectors, and the technical lead and design expertise of a larger one. In its more than ten years of design practice, the company has earned a reputation for excellence in the master planning and the design of distinctive residential, educational, laboratory facilities, recreational, retail, and mixed-use projects. The approach to projects is collaborative both within the practice itself and in its relationship with clients and consultants, among others. These lines of collaboration are established and maintained right through to the completion of a project, allowing projects, from inception, to be considered holistically - from the aesthetic dimensions to questions regarding the environment, structural integrity, and issues related to cost, program, and value. The office is located near Lisbon, in Portugal, close to the salt marshes of the Tagus River estuary. Its structure occupies the totality of a small historical building in the town center. read in Português

The [N2X] team started it’s activity in the year 2004, comprising of Isabel Ourique and Pedro Furtado, both of which studied at Faculty of Architecture on the Technical University of Lisbon between 1997 and 2003. Constant collaborators between 2003 and 2006 in various offices in Lisbon, they now practice their activity in Ponta Delgada, in the Island of S. Miguel, Azores. Architecture in it’s practical current has become the priority and objective of this team. We look for valid ideas that have solid foundation on concepts. We experiment through drawings and detail, the reflection of the modulation of spaces built that transmit simplicity and pragmatism.

Silverline is an architecture and construction studio founded in 2008 by Jorge Prata and Eduardo Soares, based in Vila Nova de Gaia. Rooted in the belief that design and execution should form a single, cohesive process, Silverline delivers integrated solutions through a close collaboration between its architecture and construction teams. Each project is approached as a unique response to its physical, social, and cultural context, balancing formal precision with functional clarity and emotional depth. The studio engages contemporary challenges by rethinking ways of living and the dialogue between public and private space. Strategic partnerships — including an ongoing collaboration with Melt81 Studio — enrich Silverline’s design approach, reinforcing its commitment to crafting architectural experiences that are thoughtful, enduring, and human-centered.

Cubic Office comprises a team of optical professionals, training and different experiences, but with a collective conception of architecture dignity and environments. Founded in 2008 by two architects (Sandrine MAIA and Susana VENÂNCIO), the sharing of approaches and ideas has been the key to answer a commitment to objectivity and effectiveness. No models or dogmas, in the face of program requests, cultural, social or economic conditions of the project and the client's wishes, the team responds to various challenges, with several alternatives and variety of answers. On this team, creativity and determination manifests itself with rigor and method, in carrying out the idea since its inception to execution, dealing with both the detail as to the fundamental: your satisfaction! O cubicoffice é composto por uma equipa de profissionais de ópticas, formação e experiências diversas, mas com uma concepção colectiva da dignidade da arquitectura e dos ambientes. Fundado em 2008 por duas arquitectas (Sandrine MAIA e Susana VENÂNCIO), a partilha de abordagens e ideias tem sido fundamental para responder a um compromisso de objectividade e eficácia. Sem modelos nem dogmas, frente às solicitações do programa, às condicionantes culturais, sociais ou económicas do projecto e às pretensões do cliente, a equipa responde a diversos desafios, com diversas alternativas e heterogeneidade de respostas. Nesta equipa, a criatividade e determinação manifesta-se com rigor e método, na realização da ideia desde a sua génese até a execução, atendendo tanto ao pormenor como ao fundamental: a sua satisfação!
